paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian aw hoihtak a na ngaihkhiak ua, tuni a thu ka hon piak, thupiak tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih uleh, TOUPA na Pathian un leitung nam tengteng a tungnungpen in ahon bawl ding hi.
heading: Thumanna Vualzawlnate / (Lev 26.3-13; Diu 7.12-24)
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh thu na zuih peuhmah uleh hiai vualzawlna tengteng na tung uah ahong tung dia, ahon zui ding uhi.
english: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

paite: Inn lam leh gam lam ah vualzawl in na om ding uh.
english: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

paite: Na gil ua gah, na lei ua gah, na ganhon, na bawngpi leh na belamhon uh vualzawl in a-om ding.
english: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

paite: Na bawm uh leh na tanghou mekna kuangte uh vualzawl in a-om ding.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

paite: Vakkhete vualzawl in na om ding ua, inn a hong lutte leng vualzawl in na om ding uh.
english: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.

paite: Na melma nou hon doute TOUPA'N ahon zohsak dia; nou hon dou ding in lampi khat ah ahong kuan ding ua, lampi sagih ah ataikek ding uh.
english: Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.

paite: TOUPA'N na buh inn tung uah, na khut koihna tengteng uah vualzawlna thu ape dia; TOUPA na Pathian un ahon gam piak ah ahon vualzawl ding hi.
english: Yahweh will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

paite: Na kiang ua ana kichiam bang in TOUPA'n amah a ding in nam siangthou ding in ahon hihkip ding, TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zuih ua, alampite na zuih phot uleh.
english: Yahweh will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and walk in his ways.

paite: Huchi in leitung a mite'n TOUPA min a sap na hi uh, chih athei ding ua, hon lau ding uhi.
english: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

paite: Nou piak dia na pi-le-pute uh TOUPA'N ana chiam gam ah na gil ua gah, na ganhon gah leh na leigah uh TOUPA'N nakpitak in apungsak ding.
english: Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.

paite: TOUPA'N ahun geihgeih in na gam uh vak ding, vuahtui hon pe ding leh na khut koihna tengteng uh hon vualzawl ding in, avan goubawm hoih akihongsak ding hi. Huchi in nam tampi na leitawisak ding ua, nou bel na leitawi kei ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

paite: TOUPA'N amei hilou in, alu in hon bawl dia, anuainung hilou in, atungnung na hi ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak, tuni a ka hon piak ngaikhia a, pilvangtak a na zuih uleh.
english: Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,

paite: Tuni a ka hon thupiak mah bang a taklam hiam, veilam hiam a pathian dangte zui leh nasem dia na pialsan kei peuhmah uleh.
english: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh aw hoihtak a na ngaihkhiak louh ua, tuni a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih kei uleh, na tung uah hiai hamsia tengteng ahong tung dia, ahon pha nawn ding uhi.
heading: Thumanlouhna Gahte / (Lev 26.14-46)
english: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.

paite: Inn lam leh gam lam ah hamsia na thuak ding uh.
english: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

paite: Na bawm uh leh na tanghou mekna kuang uh hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

paite: Na gilgahte, na leigahte leh na bawngpi uh leh na belamhon gahte hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
english: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

paite: Na pawtkhete uh hamsethuak in a-om ding ua, ahong lutte leng hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
english: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

paite: TOUPA'N na tung uah, na khut koihna tengteng uah hamsia, buaina leh salhna ahon sawl dia, na vuallel ding ua, na mangthang pah ding uh; na thilhih giloute ua kei na hon paisan ziak un.
english: Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

paite: Luah dia na lutna gam ua kipan ahon hihmanthat masiah TOUPA'N na lak uah hipi alengsak gige ding hi.
english: Yahweh will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.

paite: TOUPA'N kumzawnna, khosik, bawkna, sat huthutna, namsau, keuna leh muatna in hon gawt dia, na manthat vek masiah uh hiaite'n hon delh ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.

paite: Na lutung ua van dal ahi dia, na nuai ua lei sik ahi ding.
english: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.

paite: TOUPA'N na gam vuah uh leivui leh vut asuaksak ding a; na manthat masiah uh van a pan na tung uah ahong ke ding hi.
english: Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.

paite: TOUPA'N na melmate uh lak ah hon hihniam dia; amaute dou ding in lampi khat ah na kuankhe ding ua, lampi sagih ah na taikek ding uh. Leitung a lalgamte lak ah paihkhiak in na om ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

paite: Na luang uh tungleng vasa tengteng leh gamsa tengteng nek ding an ahi dia, mi kuamah in amaute adelhmang kei ding uh.
english: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.

paite: Hihdam theih louh Aigupta meimatum, chithak, bawkna leh vunthak in TOUPA'N ahon gawt ding hi.
english: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

paite: Haina, mittawtna leh lunglelhna in TOUPA'N ahon gawt ding.
english: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

paite: Mittaw in khomial amaimai bang in, sun khovak nangawn ah na maimai ding ua, na khosakna uah na lamzang kei ding uh. Nuaisiah ding leh gallak ding phet na hi ding ua, hon hunkhe ding kuamah a-om kei ding uhi.
english: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

paite: Zi na kham ding ua, midang in akithuahpih ding uh. Inn na lam ding ua, na luah kei ding uh. Grephuan na bawl ding ua, agah na ne kei ding uh.
english: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

paite: Na mitmuh un na bawngtal uh hon gohsak ding ua, asa na ne kei ding uh. Na mitmuh un na sabiltung uh thagum a suhsak na hi ding ua, piakkik na hi kei ding uh. Na belam uh na melmate uh piak ahi ding; hon hunkhe ding kuamah na nei kei ding uh.
english: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.

paite: Na tanute uh leh na tapate uh namdangte piak ahi ding ua, nitum in amaute ngai in na en vungvung ding ua, na etetna lam un na mitte uh avai ding; bangmah lah hihtheih na nei kei ding uhi.
english: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.

paite: Na leigah, na sepkhiak teng uh na theih louh uh nam in ane khin dia, hihgentheih leh hihsiat in na om gige ding uh.
english: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,

paite: Huchi in hiai thil mu in na hailoh ding uhi.
english: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.

paite: TOUPA'N na khuk uah, na khe uah, hihdam theih louh meimatum ahon veisak ding, na khepek ua kipan na lusip tanpha un.
english: Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

paite: Nou leh na kumpipa uh nangawn in na pi-le-pute'n atheih ngei louh uh nam kiang ah TOUPA'N ahon pi dia; huai ah pathian dangte, sing leh suang pathiante nna na sem ding uh.
english: Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

paite: TOUPA'N hon pimangna ding nam tengteng lak ah lamdang chih leh paunak leh aselam a gentehna na hong hi ding uhi.
english: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.

paite: Lou ah buhchi tampi na kuankhiakpih ding ua, tawmchik kia na la ding uh, khaupe in anegai vek ding hi.
english: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.

paite: Grephuan na bawl ding ua, na kem ding ua, himahleh a-uain na dawn kei ding uh. Grep lah na lou kei ding uh, lung in anegai ding hi.
english: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.

paite: Na gam tengteng uah olive sing na suan ding ua, himahleh athau na nilh kei ding uh, na olive gahte uh apulh khin ding hi.
english: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.

paite: Tanu tapa na suang ding ua, himahleh sal a kaihmang a, a-om ding ziak un na ompih kha kei ding uh.
english: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

paite: Na theikung tengteng uh leh na leigah tengteng uh khaupe an ahi ding.
english: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

paite: Gamdangmi na lak ua tengte na tung uah asang hiaihiai ding ua, nou na niam giaigiai ding uh.
english: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

paite: Ahon leitawisak ding ua, nou zaw na leitawisak kei ding uh. Amau alu ahi ding ua, nou amei na hi ding uh.
english: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

paite: Hiai hamsia tengteng na tung uah ahong tung dia, ahon delh dia, ahon pha dia; hihmanthat a na om masiah uh; athupiak leh adan hon piak zui dia TOUPA na Pathian aw na ngaihsak louh ziak un.
english: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

paite: Na tung uah leh na suante uh tung ah tangtawn a dia chiamtehna leh lamdang chih ding in a-om ding uhi.
english: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.

paite: Thil bangkim a na hong kiningchin ua leng TOUPA na Pathian uh lungsim kipaktak leh nuamsatak a na sepsak louh ziak un.
english: Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

paite: Huaiziak in noute hon dou dia TOUPA'N ahon sawl ding na melmate uh gilkial, dangtak leh vuaktang leh thil bangkim tasam kawm in na sepsak ding uh. Ahon hihsiat masiah uh na ngawng uah sik hakkol ahon batsak ding uhi.
english: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

paite: Gamlapi a pan, kawlmong a pan nou hon dou ding nam, TOUPA'N muvanlai ngumkiak bang in ahon sawl ding; apau uh na theih louh uh nam;
english: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,

paite: nam lauhuai melpu, upa leng khawk sa lou leh tuailaite leng deihsak tuam lou.
english: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.

paite: Na ganhon pungte leh na leigah, na manthat masiah uh ane ding ua, buh, uain, thau, na bawnghon leh na belamhonte uh ahawi kei ding uh, na tung ua manna ahon tunsak tan in.
english: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.

paite: Na gam tengteng ua na muanpen uh, na kulhsangte uh achip tan in na kulh kongpi tengteng uah ahon um ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon piak na gam tengteng ua na kulh kongpi tengteng uh ahong um ding uhi.
english: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which Yahweh your God has given you.

paite: Na melmate'n hon umbichilh ziak un leh ahon hihmangbatna uah na gil ua gah, TOUPA'N ahon piak na tanu, na tapate sa na ne ding uhi.
english: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.

paite: Na lak ua minunnem leh chingkam nangawn in leng a-unaupa, ahihkeileh azi it, a-ompih lai atate ngialtak leng a-it kei ding hi.
english: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,

paite: Bangmah aneih nawn louh ziak in atate uh sa anek ding kuamah ape kei ding hi. Ahon umna uh leh ahon khelhchipna uah, na melmate'n na kulh kongpi ua ahon khelhchip ziak un.
english: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.

paite: Na lak ua numei chinou leh chingek, achinouna leh achingekna ziak a lei leng sik nuam lou in apasal deih mahmah uh, atapate, atanute;
english: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,

paite: apom lai atasen leh ata piang lai dingte leng a-en moh ding uh. Bangkim ataksap khit ziak in asimnek ding; na melmate'n na kulh kongpi ua ahon lungkiaksak ziak un.
english: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh min thupitak leh lauhuaitak na lauhtheihna ding ua, hiai laibu a tuang thu tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih kei uleh;
heading: Pathian In Thumang Ding In Ngen
english: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH your God,

paite: TOUPA'N noute leh na suante uh tung ah hipi lamdangtak, hipi leng gige, damlouhna haksatak leng gige chi a lengsak ding hi.
english: then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.

paite: Na lauh mahmah uh Aigupta gam hiite na tung uah alengsak nawn dia, hon lenkip ding uhi.
english: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

paite: Hiai dan laibu a tuanglou, damlouhna hii chiteng leng na manthat masiah uh TOUPA'N na tung uah alengsak ding hi.
english: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

paite: Van a aksi zah hita noute tawmchik kia na hong hita ding uh; TOUPA na Pathian aw na man louh ziak un.
english: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, hon hihhoih ding leh hon pungsak dia TOUPA na tung ua akipah bang in, hon hihmang ding leh bangmah lou hon suah ding in TOUPA na tung uah akipak dia, na va luah ding uh na lutna gam ua kipan suanmang na hi ding uhi.
english: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

paite: TOUPA'N kawlmong a pan kawlmong langkhat tan in chi chih lak ah hon hihdalh dia, huai ah sing leh suang, na pi uh leh pute uh tan a na theih ngei louh uh pathian dangte nna na sem ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

paite: Hiai namte lak ah tawldamna na mu kei ding ua, na khe uh a ding in khawlna a-om kei dia; huai ah, TOUPA'N lungtang ling, mit gim leh lungsim ngui hon pe zaw ding hi.
english: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

paite: Na hinna uh lauthawng gige in a-om dia, sun leh zan in lau gige in na om ding ua, na hinna un kitheihchetna anei kei ding hi.
english: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

paite: Zingsang in, "Nitak hita maileh aw!" na chi ding ua, nitak in, "Zingsang hita maileh aw!" na chi ding uh, "Thil lauhuai na lungtang un alauh ding ziak leh na mit ua na thil muh ding uh ziak in.
english: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.

paite: Na mu nawn kei ding uh, na kiang ua ka chih lampi ah long in Aigupta gam ah TOUPA'N ahon pi nawn ding. Huai ah na melmate uh sikhapa ding leh sikhanu dia zuak na hi ding ua, kuamah in ahon lei kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.
